tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: This implementation continuation did not request test or runtime-route verification; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::CsvSort -> document::csv_sort -> DocumentResult artifact
supported_behavior_from_source: The operation requires a valid CSV with an explicit unique named header and an existing selected column.
Rows are stably ordered by the selected decoded string using exact Rust string order; equal values retain input order.
No locale collation, Unicode normalization, case folding or numeric interpretation is performed; `10` sorts as a string relative to `2`.
The result is a string-typed JSON table; original header and cell source spans map to output byte ranges.
Malformed CSV and missing columns return typed failures; row/column/cell/output bounds remain in force.
